source_caption:
I'm Gonna Git You Sucka is a comedy parody that makes fun of classic 1970s “blaxploitation” action movies. The story follows Jack Spade, played by Keenen Ivory Wayans, who returns to his hometown after his brother dies mysteriously. He soon discovers that a powerful crime boss named Mr. Big is controlling the neighborhood and decides to fight back.

Jack teams up with several exaggerated hero characters to take down the villain, leading to many ridiculous and funny scenes that mock action movie clichés. The film became a cult comedy and is known for its over-the-top humor and satire of old action films.

source_details.synopsis: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka is a 1988 American blaxploitation parody film written, directed by and starring Keenen Ivory Wayans in his directorial debut. Featured in the film are several noteworthy African-American actors who were part of the genre of blaxploitation: Jim Brown, Bernie Casey, Antonio Fargas and Isaac Hayes. It co-stars John Vernon, Kadeem Hardison, Ja'net Dubois, John Witherspoon, Damon Wayans, Clarence Williams III, Dawnn Lewis, Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans, and Chris Rock, and acts as the film debut of comedian Robin Harris.
